name: dsh-cc-switch
description: 把 cc-switch 里配好的模型供应商直接接入 DeepSeek Harness：读取 cc-switch 数据库，转换成 llm-pi-ai 路由并写入凭据，还能实测每条端点通不通。Bridges your cc-switch providers into DeepSeek Harness as llm-pi-ai routes.
author: LightingHa

summary.en: Import your cc-switch providers into DeepSeek Harness as llm-pi-ai routes, with API keys stored as credentials and a health check that measures each endpoint.
summary.zh: 把 cc-switch 里的模型供应商接进 DeepSeek Harness：自动转成 llm-pi-ai 路由、写入 API Key，并能实测每条端点通不通、快不快。

capabilities.en: Reads ~/.cc-switch/cc-switch.db (SQLite, plus the legacy config.json) and converts Claude / Codex / OpenClaw / MCode / Pi entries into llm-pi-ai provider routes.
capabilities.zh: 读取 ~/.cc-switch/cc-switch.db（SQLite，也认旧版 config.json），把 Claude / Codex / OpenClaw / MCode / Pi 等条目转成 llm-pi-ai 路由。

capabilities.en: Stores each provider's API key through the harness credential service and writes routes through the settings service, so they appear in the Models page without a restart.
capabilities.zh: 通过 harness 凭据服务存 API Key，通过 settings 服务写路由，「设置 → 模型」里立刻可见，无需重启。

capabilities.en: Adds a cc_switch tool with status / sync / plan / probe / list / skip-list actions; probe measures time-to-first-byte and whether the stream completes.
capabilities.zh: 注册 cc_switch 工具，支持 status / sync / plan / probe / list / skip-list；probe 实测首字节耗时与流是否正常收尾。

capabilities.en: Only ever touches routes it owns (ccswitch- prefix plus a state manifest); official OAuth providers and Gemini-native endpoints are skipped with an explicit reason.
capabilities.zh: 只动自己拥有的路由（ccswitch- 前缀 + 清单文件）；官方 OAuth 供应商与 Gemini 原生端点会被跳过并说明原因。
